question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing striker, Bob is playing benchwarmer, Claire is playing left midfielder, Dave is playing center midfielder, Eve is playing fullback, Fred is playing left winger, and Gertrude is playing right midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Fred trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Claire and Gertrude trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) striker
(B) benchwarmer
(C) left midfielder
(D) center midfielder
(E) fullback
(F) left winger
(G) right midfielder
solution:
Positions are listed in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: striker, benchwarmer, left midfielder, center midfielder, fullback, left winger, right midfielder
1. Eve ↔ Fred: striker, benchwarmer, left midfielder, center midfielder, left winger, fullback, right midfielder
2. Eve ↔ Dave: striker, benchwarmer, left midfielder, left winger, center midfielder, fullback, right midfielder
3. Bob ↔ Dave: striker, left winger, left midfielder, benchwarmer, center midfielder, fullback, right midfielder
4. Claire ↔ Dave: striker, left winger, benchwarmer, left midfielder, center midfielder, fullback, right midfielder
5. Eve ↔ Dave: striker, left winger, benchwarmer, center midfielder, left midfielder, fullback, right midfielder
6. Bob ↔ Gertrude: striker, right midfielder, benchwarmer, center midfielder, left midfielder, fullback, left winger
7. Claire ↔ Gertrude: striker, right midfielder, left winger, center midfielder, left midfielder, fullback, benchwarmer
Eve is playing left midfielder, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
